recap: Thirty-nine days, and Episode 3 took two of them off the board. First, Rob — after a night alone on the beach and a tiny cut on the bottom of his foot — got looked at by Dr. Barry, heard there was no sign of infection but 'always the risk,' and told his tribe the feeling in his leg wasn't right: 'I gotta go.' Then came the old-school twist. Devin volunteered to visit Savu, Carter got randomly selected for Toka, and both learned they could mutiny — and exactly where an advantage was hidden. Devin slipped away during a one-on-one with Sharonda, grabbed an extra vote at the water well, and went home to Toka. Carter left his note on top of his bag, Toka smashed their oars hunting the prize, and he missed his ride back. Savu took reward and immunity. At Tribal, Kilby took five votes — Patt took six.
bullets: Rob's exit stung: tens of thousands apply, and Kristin was sitting there with broken bones in her foot.
Maggie dug the longest, Brady grabbed the parchment first — then traded it for a vote she broke that very night.
Devin didn't mutiny, but he torched Kilby's name on his way out the door — bold.
Thien An found her voice, helped build a six-person outlier plan, then walked it straight to Brady.
Brady said the plan had no chance in God's green Earth; six parchments for Patt said otherwise, and then there were 17.
draftImpact: Tami, this one hurt — Rob quit and Patt got blindsided, so you lost two in a single hour, though your 8 → 15 (+7) keeps you right in it with 3 of 5 still breathing. Tim and Austin had the clean night: both 8 → 16 (+8), both with 4 of 4 standing, and both sitting tied at the top. Taylor, your Brady made the big call: 7 → 13 (+6). Kylie, Kilby survived five votes and you're at 6 → 12 (+6). Austin and Tim lead at 16.
